title: Items Sold by Weight — Weighing and Billing Standard
content:
## Weighing standard — items sold by weight

This standard governs how produce, meat and deli sold by weight are billed on a Cartwise Grocery Orders order.

1. Produce, meat and deli sold by weight (item class weighted) are billed on the weight handed over.
2. *Retired, no longer in force:* when the billed weight exceeds the requested weight by more than the service level's weighted-item tolerance, the charge for the weight above the requested weight enlarged by that tolerance is refunded as a weight overage refund, rounded to the cent. This clause is superseded by the current basis.
3. Weight shortfalls are not refunded, because they are already billed at the lower weight.
4. A weight overage refund does not count toward the per-order self-service cap or toward the rolling refund limits.

### Points of judgement

| Weight handed over compared with the weight requested | Position under this standard |
|---|---|
| Less than requested | Billed on the lower weight handed over; no refund for the shortfall (clause 3) |
| Equal to requested | Billed on the weight handed over |
| More than requested | Billed on the weight handed over (clause 1) |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer asks for 2.00 pounds of salmon and the shopper hands over 1.80 pounds. The line on the Cartwise Grocery Orders order is billed on 1.80 pounds; the 0.20 pound shortfall is not refunded, because it was never billed. A weight overage refund booked on some other weighed line of the same order leaves the order's per-order self-service cap and the customer's rolling refund figures untouched (clause 4).

superseded_clauses: When the billed weight exceeds the requested weight by more than weighted_item_tolerance_pct, the charge for the weight above requested weight times (1 + weighted_item_tolerance_pct / 100) is refunded with refund_reason weight_overage, rounded to the cent.
